description: Negative fixtures: each MUST FAIL validation against its schema. Consumed by console/tests/test_managed_platform_schemas.py::test_invalid_examples_are_rejected. `version` selects the schema directory (defaults to v1alpha1).

cases.reason: entitlement signature must be ed25519, not sigstore-cosign
metadata.nonce is required (replay protection)
owner_access must be preserved and export_available true in every state
expired must pause premium agents/tasks and read-only additional users
public lane pins mirrorable true (only mirrorable is flipped: fails the mirrorable const alone)
public lane REQUIRES mirrorable/requires_hub_account/distribution; omitting mirrorable must fail (item 3)
verified-premium requires a non-empty required_entitlements
restricted lane pins mirrorable false; a grant-gated pack cannot be freely mirrorable (item 4)
source personal_base MUST declare edition personal (item 1)
source verified_entitlement MUST carry entitlement_ref (item 1 reciprocal)
personal_base pins subscription_state to active when present; a degraded state (suspended) is rejected (N1)
memberships must contain exactly one owner; zero owners is rejected (item 2)
memberships must contain exactly one owner; two owners is rejected (item 2)
OrganizationId is lowercase-canonical so it round-trips inside a PackageScope (item 5)
managed modality presupposes team/organization edition, not personal
a ref carries only ref_name+service; embedding a plaintext value is forbidden (no plaintext secret values)
spec.hub is pinned const none; Personal has NO Hub dependency (no Hub dependency invariant)
metadata.stack_id is pinned const personal-local-v1 (fixed stack identity)
llm.providers has minItems 1; at least one of anthropic/openai must be configured (one-or-both provider refs)
llm.providers[].provider enum is anthropic/openai only; ollama is not a default bootstrap provider
a provider entry forbids value/api_key/token/key fields; keys come by reference only (no plaintext secret values)
spec.boundaries.multi_user is pinned const false; Personal is single-owner (multi-user prohibition)
spec.llm.provider_fallback is pinned const false; no fallback to a different provider after failure
spec.llm.priority is pinned const [anthropic, openai]; deterministic order cannot be reversed
spec.llm.providers is uniqueItems; the same provider must not appear twice
spec.llm.retry.max_retries is pinned const 1; exactly one retry of a provider request
spec.runtime.components is pinned const [api, reconciliation_operator, console]; the single runtime process cannot drop the reconciliation operator
spec.runtime.ports[].bind_host is pinned const 127.0.0.1; no public/0.0.0.0 bind
setup_md.is_source_of_truth is pinned const false; the handoff Markdown must never be the machine source of truth
